resources.string: Two MASQUE tunnels: the second runs through the first, with a different entry and exit. Slower; both endpoints are optional.
Endpoint this device connects to. Leave blank to let the scanner choose. A manual endpoint below overrides it.
Endpoint reached through the first. Leave blank to let the scanner choose.
Starts with QUIC v2 to help pass filters that block QUIC v1. Leave it on unless your network blocks v2.
Marks the engine\'s sockets so a tunnel front end can route around them. Requires root or CAP_NET_ADMIN; leave blank on a normal device.
Limits for the engine. Blank uses automatic device-based sizing.
Maximum proxy connections at once. The engine chooses 512 to 8192 from device limits; raise it only if apps stall while the tunnel is idle.
Lower values release dead connections sooner; higher values keep long sessions open longer on unstable mobile links.
